# A table under a `for`, on every target.
#
# bubbletea keeps a bubbles model per copy of a widget a loop renders, and
# passImplicitState gives a table nobody binds a `selected` cell per copy. The
# copy accessor took the cell's value only for a widget whose value it syncs,
# which a table is not, while every call handed it the cell: `too many
# arguments in call to m.widget0Copy`. The call and the accessor now ask one
# question (copyTakesValue). The table is also written under an indexed loop
# with its rows under a `for` and an `if`, and in a component rendered under
# two loops, each of which met the same error.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component groups ui.node {
    var names = ["a", "b"]

    for var g = names {
        ui.text #title(value=g)
        ui.table(columns=["name"]) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=[g])
        }
    }
}

component indexed ui.node {
    var groups = [["a", "b"], ["c"]]

    for var i, g = groups {
        ui.text #at(value="{i}")
        ui.table(columns=["name"]) {
            for var c = g {
                if c != "b" {
                    ui.tableRow(cells=[c])
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ui.button #add(text="add", @click { groups.push(["d"]) })
}

component grid(cells list[string]) ui.node {
    ui.table(columns=["name"]) {
        ui.tableRow(cells=cells)
    }
}

component nested ui.node {
    var outer = [[["a"], ["b"]], [["c"]]]

    for var gs = outer {
        for var g = gs {
            ui.text #first(value=g[0])
            grid(cells=g)
        }
    }
}

func testEachGroupHasItsTable(t test.Test, c groups) {
    t.assert(c.title[1] != null && c.title[1].value == "b")
}

func testAnIndexedLoopGrows(t test.Test, c indexed) {
    c.add.click()
    t.assert(c.at[2].value == "2")
}

func testANestedLoopBuildsEachGrid(t test.Test, c nested) {
    t.assert(c.first[0][1].value == "b")
    t.assert(c.first[1][0].value == "c")
}
